summary: CAPSTONE wired: the self-scheduling decideAction loop now joins planner+judge+learnings+escalation, with cooperative in-process self-stop. Built ON existing primitives (decideAction router, loop_start/stop/status, /should-stop, /guidance, /learnings, self-learn-planner/judge skills) — no parallel mechanism. CHANGES (surgical, 4 files): (1) daemon.js: extracted stopSignalFor(session) as the single source of truth for the cooperative-stop probe; refactored /should-stop to use it; added a stop-poll at the TOP of decideAction() (highest precedence, before escalation gate) so EVERY heartbeat tick checks the loop session's stop signal (cancel on its claimed task OR stop on its agent) and self-exits within one iteration — action:'stop',reason:'cooperative stop', clears loop.active, persisted via the existing saveLoop() at the /next-action call site. This is the load-bearing adoption: the heartbeat runs in-process where the PreToolUse hook can't reach, so the daemon enforces the stop server-side. Added loop.session (set by loop_start, persisted in loop.json). (2) lib/mcp-core.js: loop_start MCP schema gains optional `session`. (3) skills/orch-loop/SKILL.md: added the 'plan' tick branch (invoke self-learn-planner -> reads get_learnings, proposes parallelism-maximizing initiatives, structures try-alternatives as problem->attempts->judge so verdicts feed back as durable learning, request_guidance on user calls) + a 'Cooperative stop' section + await_user note. (4) test/smoke.sh: +7 assertions (drained+self_plan->plan; drained+no self_plan->stop; loop armed w/ session; armed loop ticks normally; should-stop sees flag; loop self-exits 'cooperative stop'; loop.active cleared). TESTS: 45/45 (was 38/38 baseline, zero regressions); both new behaviors — one plan tick + self-exit within one iteration on a simulated stop — verified against the isolated :8799 daemon. GAPS: live :8787 daemon (PID 59236) was NOT restarted (LIVE, per policy) — changes are on disk only; needs a restart-by-P
